candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (Supplement to the Official Journal of the EU)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory publication venue for EU external-action (IPA) contract notices, prior information notices and contract award notices concerning Montenegro, and for EIB-financed project procurement outside the EU. Covers financial-sector IT, payment systems and public financial management assignments tendered by the EU Delegation to Montenegro and by Montenegrin contracting authorities under EU rules. Structured, searchable, with CPV codes and open bulk/API access.
candidates.source_subtype: official tender gazette / procurement notice database
candidates.legal_status: open data (EU re-use policy / CC-BY-equivalent for OJ S data)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED Search API v3 / bulk XML packages filtered by place-of-performance ME (Montenegro) plus CPV 66xxxxxx (financial services), 72xxxxxx (IT services), 48xxxxxx (software); daily incremental pull
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + first-principles reasoning about mandatory publication venues
queries_used: TED tender notice Montenegro payment system information technology

candidates.source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (SEDIA) — external actions calls and tenders
candidates.why_relevant: Single entry point for EC-managed procurement and grants, including PRAG-governed external-action service/supply contracts for IPA beneficiaries such as Montenegro. Carries call documentation (ToRs) that TED abstracts omit — ToRs are the richest description of what payments/PFM systems the EU intends to fund.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Portal search API / opportunity screen filtered by programme IPA III and country Montenegro; download ToR annexes where anonymous access is allowed
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from PRAG / external-actions procurement search
queries_used: EU Funding and Tenders Portal external actions PRAG "Montenegro" service contract notice financial

candidates.source_name: Delegation of the European Union to Montenegro — tenders and calls
candidates.why_relevant: The EU Delegation directly launches, awards and manages a large share of IPA contracts in Montenegro under PRAG, and publishes/mirrors its own calls for tenders. It is the contracting authority for many digital-government and PFM technical-assistance contracts, and it publishes bilingual (en/me) news items naming projects and beneficiaries before formal notices appear.
candidates.source_subtype: donor country office / contracting authority page
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the delegation's tenders and press sections in both /en and /me locale variants; keyword filter on plaćanja, digitalizacija, finansije, payments, treasury
candidates.discovered_via_method: targeted search + snowball from IPA glossary
queries_used: EU Delegation Montenegro "calls for tenders" IPA site:eeas.europa.eu delegations montenegro tenders

candidates.source_name: European Commission DG NEAR — Montenegro financial assistance under IPA
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative programming layer: annual/multiannual IPA action documents for Montenegro state which sectors (public financial management, digital public services, payments) will be tendered 12-24 months ahead. Best early-warning source for pipeline before any notice exists.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of action-document PDFs; extract sector fiches and indicative budgets
queries_used: EU Delegation Montenegro "calls for tenders" IPA

candidates.source_name: ECEPP — EBRD Client eProcurement Portal
candidates.why_relevant: Since the migration away from ebrd.com notices, ECEPP is the sole publication venue for procurement, prequalification, shortlisting and contract-award notices for EBRD loan- and grant-financed contracts, including Montenegro consultancy and IT assignments. Montenegro notices are demonstrably present (e.g. PIU Support assignments with contract values and signature dates), which makes it usable both for opportunities and for award/competitor intelligence.
candidates.legal_status: public notices; portal ToU applies to automated access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Filtered notice search by country=Montenegro; capture displayNoticeId list and diff daily; respect ToU and rate-limit
queries_used: EBRD procurement notice Montenegro financial sector consultancy

candidates.source_name: EBRD Procurement Notices (corporate landing / redirect layer)
candidates.why_relevant: Explains the split between client procurement (ECEPP) and EBRD's own corporate/consultancy procurement (SMART by GEP), and hosts procurement policy and rules. Needed to know which channel a given Montenegro financial-sector assignment will appear on.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl to detect channel/policy changes
queries_used: EBRD procurement notice Montenegro financial sector consultancy

candidates.source_name: EBRD corporate consultancy opportunities via SMART by GEP
candidates.why_relevant: EBRD-funded advisory and technical-cooperation assignments (financial-sector policy, digital finance, payments diagnostics) contracted by the Bank itself rather than by a client are advertised here, not on ECEPP. These are exactly the small advisory contracts that precede larger Montenegro payments investments.
candidates.access_status: registration likely required for full opportunity list
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor public listing page; register a supplier profile if deeper access is required (manual, not scraped)
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from EBRD procurement landing page
queries_used: EBRD procurement notice Montenegro financial sector consultancy

candidates.source_name: World Bank Projects & Operations — procurement notices and contract details
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes General Procurement Notices, Specific Procurement Notices, REOIs and contract-award details (fed from STEP) for Bank-financed Montenegro operations, including the EUR 8m Financial Infrastructure Modernization / SEPA TIPS-clone project. This is the single most on-target donor channel for Montenegro payments-infrastructure procurement.
candidates.legal_status: World Bank open data / CC-BY 4.0 for most datasets
candidates.suggested_collection_method: World Bank Projects & Operations API filtered by countrycode=ME; plus procurement-detail pages (OP00... ids); cross-join with Finances One contract-award datasets
queries_used: World Bank procurement Montenegro treasury payment digitalisation contract award

candidates.source_name: World Bank — Montenegro Financial Infrastructure Modernization / SEPA (TIPS Clone) project documents
candidates.why_relevant: Project Appraisal Document (Report No. PADHI01235) for the flagship Montenegro payments project; contains the procurement plan summary, components, implementing agency (Central Bank of Montenegro / Ministry of Finance) and indicative contract packages for the TIPS-clone instant-payment build. Directly names what will be tendered.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Documents & Reports API by project id; fetch PAD PDF and extract the procurement annex; re-check for restructuring papers and ISRs
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from World Bank procurement seed query
queries_used: Montenegro Financial Infrastructure Modernization SEPA TIPS World Bank project procurement plan

candidates.source_name: World Bank Group Finances One — contract awards datasets
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable historical contract-award data by supplier country, procurement method and fiscal year. Lets you see which vendors actually won Bank-financed contracts in Montenegro — competitor and price benchmarking rather than opportunity spotting.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Dataset API/CSV pull (DS01529, DS01666) filtered to Montenegro; quarterly refresh
queries_used: World Bank procurement Montenegro treasury payment digitalisation contract award

candidates.source_name: World Bank corporate procurement contract awards
candidates.why_relevant: Bank's own (non-borrower) purchases of advisory and IT services; occasionally covers Western Balkans payments diagnostics and financial-inclusion studies that shape later lending. Secondary but cheap to monitor.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly page crawl
queries_used: World Bank procurement Montenegro treasury payment digitalisation contract award

candidates.source_name: UNDP Procurement Notices — Montenegro country feed
candidates.why_relevant: UNDP Montenegro implements EU-funded digital-government and e-services projects (e.g. the EU/UNDP e-services and digital infrastructure programme with the Ministry of Public Administration) and tenders hardware, software and digital-expert consultancies under its own rules. A country-scoped RSS feed makes this the cheapest high-signal donor feed in the cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the MTN.xml RSS feed daily; resolve view_notice.cfm / view_negotiation.cfm detail pages
queries_used: UNDP Montenegro procurement notices UNGM tender digital payments

candidates.source_name: UNGM — United Nations Global Marketplace public notices
candidates.why_relevant: System-wide UN tender board covering UNDP, UNICEF, UNOPS, IOM etc.; catches Montenegro assignments (e.g. 'Digital Expert' roles) that never reach national channels. Also carries contract-award archives useful for competitor mapping.
candidates.legal_status: portal ToU; a paid 'UNGM Pro' tier exists for enhanced access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Public notice search filtered by beneficiary country Montenegro; polite scheduled polling, or evaluate UNGM Pro for licensed bulk access
queries_used: UNDP Montenegro procurement notices UNGM tender digital payments

candidates.source_name: EIB — procurement for Bank-financed projects and technical assistance calls
candidates.why_relevant: EIB requires promoters to publish notices in OJEU and/or on eib.org for non-EU projects; Montenegro entries are demonstrably present (railway tunnels, PIU support for the Montenegro Education Programme). PIU-support and technical-assistance calls are the template under which financial-management/payment-system TA would be tendered if EIB co-finances it.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl calls-for-technical-assistance and call-projects-non-EU listings, filter title/body for 'Montenegro'/'ME —'; cross-check against TED
queries_used: EIB Montenegro procurement notices tenders financial institutions site:eib.org

candidates.source_name: WBIF — Western Balkans Investment Framework procurements page
candidates.why_relevant: WBIF blends EU grants with EBRD/EIB/CEB/KfW lending and publishes a forward-looking table of upcoming procurement opportunities plus the Infrastructure Project Facility (IPF) technical-assistance lots that explicitly include the 'digital economy' sector. IPF lots are the vehicle through which Montenegro digital/financial-infrastructure feasibility work gets contracted.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /procurements table and the project database filtered to Montenegro; diff for new upcoming opportunities
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles reasoning about blended donor channels + search
queries_used: Western Balkans Investment Framework WBIF Montenegro procurement digital financial infrastructure

candidates.source_name: Directorate for Public Procurement Policy of Montenegro — 'EU tenderi' category
candidates.why_relevant: National re-publication point where donor/EU-funded tenders (supervision, consultancy, including climate-finance consultancy) are mirrored in Montenegrin. Bridges the supranational channel back into local-language vocabulary, and is the best place to harvest the local terms used for donor tenders (poziv za dostavljanje ponuda, obavještenje o ugovoru, EU tenderi).
candidates.source_subtype: national procurement authority — donor tender mirror
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the category listing in both /en and Montenegrin locale; use it as a cross-check that no donor tender was missed upstream
queries_used: "Ministarstvo finansija" Crna Gora "javne nabavke" IPA "ugovaranje" EU pomoć gov.me

candidates.source_name: Ministarstvo finansija Crne Gore — EU fondovi / Direktorat za ugovaranje i finansiranje sredstava EU pomoći (CFCU)
candidates.why_relevant: Montenegro's CFCU is the national contracting authority for IPA operational programmes under indirect management: it prepares, concludes and monitors EU-funded contracts. Notices and award information for IPA contracts run through this directorate, in Montenegrin, and it is the actor to name-map when reading TED notices with a Montenegrin contracting authority.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl gov.me/mif EU-fondovi subtree and the ministry's document downloads (wapi.gov.me); OCR annual work reports for contract lists
queries_used: Direktorat za finansiranje i ugovaranje sredstava EU pomoći CFCU Crna Gora tenderi
"Ministarstvo finansija" Crna Gora "javne nabavke" IPA "ugovaranje" EU pomoć gov.me
local_language_terms_used: Direktorat za ugovaranje i finansiranje sredstava EU pomoći

candidates.source_name: Revizorsko tijelo Crne Gore (Audit Authority for EU funds) — IPA section
candidates.why_relevant: Audits IPA-funded procurement in Montenegro. Audit reports reveal which contracts were actually signed and executed, where procedures failed, and which bodies mismanage donor tenders — high-value indirect intelligence not obtainable from notice feeds.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual crawl of IPA report PDFs; extract contract references and irregularity findings
queries_used: IPA projekat Crna Gora tender digitalizacija javne uprave plaćanja

candidates.source_name: KfW Development Bank — procurement guidelines and financed-project tenders
candidates.why_relevant: KfW finances Western Balkans financial-sector and SME-finance operations; procurement is run by the borrower under KfW's own Guidelines for Procurement, so notices scatter across borrower websites and aggregators rather than a single KfW board. Montenegro-located tender openings under KfW financing do occur (e.g. a WB6 Chamber Investment Forum tender opened in Podgorica). Track the guidelines to know where notices must land, and monitor borrower sites.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the KfW procurement guidelines PDF for rule changes; rely on aggregators and borrower/PIU sites for actual Montenegro notices
queries_used: KfW Entwicklungsbank tender notices Montenegro consulting assignments procurement portal

candidates.source_name: dgMarket — aggregated donor tender notices
candidates.why_relevant: Cross-donor aggregator carrying World Bank, EU, UN and national donor notices in one place. Useful as a recall safety net and for retrospective searching when a donor portal has poor archives; not authoritative and partly paywalled, so treat as secondary.
candidates.access_status: freemium — summaries free, full notices behind subscription
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/licensed use only for gap-filling; do not scrape
queries_used: "Development Business" OR dgMarket OR UNGM Montenegro tender notice financial sector payments IFI
candidates.observed_blocker: Full notice text and archives require a paid subscription

candidates.source_name: Commercial Montenegro tender aggregators (TendersInfo, GlobalTenders, TendersOnTime, BidDetail, Jorpex)
candidates.why_relevant: These resell TED, EBRD, World Bank and UN notices for Montenegro. Their public landing pages are occasionally useful for discovering that a notice exists, and their funding-agency taxonomies are a cheap way to enumerate which donors actually tender in Montenegro. Content itself is paywalled and unverified — never a primary source.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not collect; use only manually as a discovery hint, then verify at the originating donor portal

negative_findings.description: No dedicated IFC (private-sector arm) procurement or advisory-services notice channel specific to Montenegro financial-sector or payments projects was located during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced only World Bank (IBRD/IDA) borrower procurement and corporate procurement pages; IFC advisory engagements in Montenegro were not visible as published tender notices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: IFC works with commercial banks and fintechs directly and typically contracts advisers without public notices, so this channel is likely structurally opaque rather than merely unfound — collection design should not assume an IFC feed exists.

negative_findings.description: Supranational tender channels publish in English almost exclusively; local-language (sr/me) searches for donor tenders returned programme/news pages rather than notice feeds.
negative_findings.result_summary: Montenegrin-language queries on IPA digitalisation and Ministry of Finance contracting produced gov.me policy pages, EEAS news, UNDP press releases and an academic article — but the only genuinely Montenegrin-language donor-tender listing found was the ujn.gov.me 'EU tenderi' category.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It confirms the cell's premise: this channel is an English-language island, and a Montenegrin-only monitoring strategy would miss essentially all of it. Conversely, sr-language monitoring is still needed to catch national re-publication and CFCU award information.

negative_findings.description: No Montenegro-specific EBRD procurement notice explicitly for financial-sector or payments consultancy was found in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Montenegro notices located on ECEPP were PIU support, infrastructure supervision and a wind farm; the financial-sector consultancy hypothesis remains unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: EBRD's Montenegro financial-sector engagement may run through credit lines and corporate advisory (SMART by GEP) rather than client procurement, which changes which portal to monitor.

negative_findings.description: The World Bank Projects list page could not be resolved to the SEPA/TIPS project's P-number via fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: projects.worldbank.org search page returned a near-empty JS shell; the project was instead identified through its Documents & Reports record (Report No. PADHI01235, document id 099070925154540128).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The projects portal is JS-rendered — a naive HTML crawler will silently return nothing. Collection must use the World Bank API, not page scraping. This is a rendering issue, not a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: Council of Europe Development Bank (CEB), IFC, and bilateral donors beyond KfW (e.g. Austrian ADA, Italian Cooperation, USAID successors, Swiss SECO) were not systematically checked for Montenegro financial-sector tenders.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass over CEB, SECO, ADA and Italian Cooperation procurement pages filtered for Montenegro and financial/PFM sectors.

coverage_gaps.description: The procurement plan for the World Bank SEPA/TIPS-clone project (indicative contract packages, methods, timing) was not extracted; only the PAD was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the PAD PDF procurement annex and the project's STEP-fed procurement-plan page to enumerate forthcoming payment-system contract packages and the implementing agency (Central Bank of Montenegro / Ministry of Finance).

coverage_gaps.description: ECEPP and UNGM lack confirmed, ToU-compliant bulk/API access paths; only per-notice URLs were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check ECEPP and UNGM terms of use and any official API/RSS or notification-subscription feature; prefer official email alerts over scraping where no API exists.

coverage_gaps.description: The Montenegrin-language vocabulary for donor tenders was only partially harvested (EU tenderi, poziv za dostavljanje ponuda, obavještenje o ugovoru, ugovaranje, IPA, digitalizacija plaćanja); no controlled glossary with transliterations and noisy-term flags was produced.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a sr/me glossary from ujn.gov.me 'EU tenderi' items and CFCU documents; flag 'nabavka' and 'tender' as high-noise generic terms requiring donor-name qualifiers.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical award archives (who won past donor-funded Montenegro financial/IT contracts) were only touched via Finances One; TED and ECEPP award histories were not mined.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill 2015-2026 contract award notices from TED bulk data (place of performance ME) and ECEPP award notices to build a supplier/competitor map.

brief: Montenegro's donor-funded tender channel is a small, English-dominated, well-structured set of publication venues that sits almost entirely outside the national eProcurement system: TED and the EU Funding & Tenders Portal for IPA/PRAG contracts (with the EU Delegation and the Ministry of Finance CFCU as contracting authorities), ECEPP for EBRD client procurement, projects.worldbank.org plus Finances One for World Bank operations, UNDP's Montenegro RSS feed and UNGM for UN agencies, and WBIF/EIB for blended technical assistance. The single most on-target anchor right now is the World Bank's EUR 8m Financial Infrastructure Modernization and SEPA alignment (TIPS-clone) project, whose appraisal documentation names the payments-infrastructure work that will be tendered; its procurement plan is the highest-value next extraction. Local-language coverage is genuinely thin by nature of the channel — the only meaningful Montenegrin-language surface found is the Directorate for Public Procurement Policy's 'EU tenderi' category plus CFCU and Audit Authority material, which matter for award and execution intelligence rather than opportunity spotting. Commercial aggregators (dgMarket, TendersInfo and peers) duplicate these feeds behind paywalls and should be treated as non-collectable hints, never as sources.
